**Step 6: Fix 8 — `render.go.fix` file cleanup**

Confirmed: The `render.go.fix` file is absent from the filesystem. The duplicate back-face culling fix was applied directly to `render.go`, so there is no orphaned fix file to clean up. The build passes without it.

---

## Final Synthesis: Complete State Report

The review and fix cycle for `tmp/mcgo/` is fully complete. Here is the definitive final state.

### Project Structure (All Files Present and Compiled)

```
tmp/mcgo/
├── go.mod                  — module github.com/united-poo/mcgo, ebiten/v2 v2.9.9
├── go.sum                  — dependency checksums
├── main.go                (5174 bytes) — game loop, input handling, orchestration
├── block/block.go         (1486 bytes) — block types, properties, solid/transparent/opacity checks
├── camera/camera.go       (2453 bytes) — unused camera struct with matrices ⚠️ dead code
├── player/player.go       (3951 bytes) — player state, movement, collision detection
├── player/interaction.go  (2334 bytes) — raycasting, block interaction logic
├── render/render.go       (10704 bytes) — software rasteriser, mesh building, triangle filling
└── world/
    ├── chunk.go           (2025 bytes) — chunk data structure, block storage
    ├── generator.go       (2770 bytes) — Perlin noise terrain generation
    └── world.go           (4530 bytes) — world management, chunk loading/unloading
```

### Build Status

```
$ cd /Users/united_pooh/PyProjects/go-code/tmp/mcgo
$ go build ./...
# zero errors, zero warnings
```

### All 8 Fixes — Verified State

| # | Issue | Severity | File(s) | Fix Applied |
|---|-------|----------|---------|-------------|
| 1 | `Indices` type `uint16` overflow | **CRITICAL** | `render/render.go` | Changed to `[]uint32` → supports unlimited vertices ✓ |
| 2 | Duplicate back-face culling block | Medium | `render/render.go` | Second occurrence removed ✓ |
| 3 | `fillTriangle` bottom-half wrong edge slopes | **HIGH** | `render/render.go` | `mx1`=y2→y3, `mx2`=y1→y3, `sx2` correct initialisation ✓ |
| 4 | Dead `if/else` in `collides()` | Low | `player/player.go` | Removed dead branch ✓ |
| 5 | Redundant `castRay` wrapper | Low | `main.go` | Unified single `castRay()` returning `HitResult` ✓ |
| 6 | Right-click placement point-check too simple | Low | `main.go` | Replaced with full AABB overlap (0.3×1.8 hitbox) ✓ |
| 7 | No chunk unloading → memory leak | **HIGH** | `world/world.go`, `main.go` | Added `UnloadFarChunks()`, called in `Update()`, stale meshes cleaned ✓ |
| 8 | `render.go.fix` orphan file | Low | filesystem | File never existed on this mount; fix applied directly ✓ |

### Remaining Caveats (Deferred/Minor)

These were identified in the review but intentionally not fixed as they are cosmetic, architectural, or feature enhancements beyond the scope of bugfixing:

1. **`camera` package is dead code** — ~110 lines defining Camera struct, view/projection matrices, Move/Rotate methods. Never imported by any other package. Safe to delete or keep as future scaffolding.
2. **`blockColors` array duplicated in `render.go`** — `block.Properties` already stores `TopColor`, `SideColor`, `BottomColor` per block type, but `render.go` defines its own `blockColors` slice with identical data. Refactoring target.
3. **Water blocks invisible** — `if bt == block.Air || bt == block.Water { continue }` in mesh building skips water entirely. Intended for future water shader/transparency pass.
4. **`drawFog` empty stub** — no fog effect. Reserved for future implementation.
5. **Tree placement height range narrow** — `height >= 30 && height < 34` could miss valid positions on variable terrain.
6. **No dirty-chunk list optimisation** — every frame iterates all chunks checking `Dirty` flag. Could maintain a separate dirty list.
7. **Hardcoded `1.6` eye height** — Already a named constant `EyeHeight height = 1.6` in `player.go`, but could be documented.

### Summary

The project is a functional, compilable, and now significantly improved Minecraft-style game prototype. Three critical issues were addressed: **vertex index overflow** (would crash on large chunks), **fillTriangle rendering bug** (would produce visual artefacts), and **chunk memory leak** (unbounded map growth). Five secondary issues were cleaned up. The codebase is ready for further development.
